description: (needs account token) Add a free receive-only address, such as info@yourdomain.com, on a domain whose email is on. It forwards to the main inbox, or with forward_to to the human's own mailbox such as Gmail. Free. An extra sending mailbox costs money and stays a dashboard step. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

forward_to.description: Optional: the human's own email address to forward to. Default: the main inbox.

site.description: The address of the site whose domain has email on (from list_sites).

name: add_email_forward
